entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Isaac. I... I'm a bit lost. I bought a VeloBand GPS Tracker and I need to return it, I think? I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It works fine, it's just not for me. The main problem is I tried to do the return on the website and it just wouldn't work at all. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I'm sorry you had trouble with our site. Can you tell me when you first tried to process that return?

I think it was about ten days ago. The whole page just gave me a big 'website error' message. I remember the whole system seemed to be down. I even took a screenshot of it, but then I got busy with the holiday and forgot.

I understand. Let me check our system logs... and yes, I can confirm we had a known outage that day that was affecting the returns portal. It shows that you couldn't print the label due to that error. I do apologize for that.

Let me just pull up your account and the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see you're a VIP member with us, thank you for your loyalty. And looking at our knowledge base here, it confirms that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I was too late.

Not at all. You received the band 19 days ago, so you are well within that 90-day window. I've gone ahead and overridden the system lock due to the previous error. I am processing the full refund for you and have just sent a new pre-paid return label to your email.
Oh, thank you so much, Isaac! That's wonderful. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. And for the trouble you had with our website during the outage, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. We really value you as a customer.
Wow, you really didn't have to do that! Thank you again. I really appreciate your help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Great. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
